narrative.intro: Noridian Healthcare Solutions has $329M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date, from 7 awards with an average award size of $47M. Obligations are up 39.2% year over year. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). Obligations by fiscal year have varied: FY21 $324M, FY22 $291M, FY23 $154M, FY24 $252M, FY25 $236M, FY26 $329M. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers is the largest market for Noridian Healthcare Solutions at $292M. All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services accounts for $36.9M, and Computer Systems Design Services shows $0 in obligations. The company’s FY2026 activity is concentrated in health and insurance-related NAICS, with most dollars tied to one primary market. Award count and average award size indicate a small number of large awards in the current fiscal year. Readers should note that award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables would be total contract values, while the figures shown here are contract obligations.

sections.heading: How have Noridian Healthcare Solutions’ obligations moved over time?
sections.body: Noridian Healthcare Solutions recorded obligations of $324M in FY21, $291M in FY22, $154M in FY23, $252M in FY24, $236M in FY25, and $329M in FY26.
